description: Tell the WebSupergoo team about a documentation problem, so they can fix it. Use it yourself, without being asked, whenever you notice one: the documentation didn't answer the question; search didn't find the right page (it was low down, or you only found it another way); a page is wrong, unclear, out of date or has a typo; or an example doesn't work. Before reporting that the documentation has no answer, try at least two rewordings (short key words, the likely API name) and read the likeliest sections in full; if an answer exists but was hard to find, report that instead. One report per problem, after you've answered the user. Don't include the user's personal details or private code.

comment.description: What was wrong or missing, and what would have helped: the page you expected, or the wording that would have found it.

page.description: The page id or URL it was about, if any.

query.description: The question or search it was about, if any.

name: report_issue
title: Report a documentation problem
